reviewKind: Independent working-source advisory; not task approval
disposition: The manifest-only P2 is corrected in the reviewed working sources; actual-build and final commit-bound qualification remain separate.

checks.scope: Real product validator and synthetic files; declared Cargo, Git inventory, tool-environment and PE-verifier doubles. No native executable built or run.
Only changed helper and regression module.

assessment: The existing product validator requires exact source and artifact inventories, current hashes, approved reference identity, and the intended frontend boundary.
The helper captures and rereads manifest bytes around validation before deriving paths; this closes the tested manifest replacement window.
Every observed path is passed through existing canonical confinement and stable regular-file reads. Product hashes must still match the validated manifest.

The complete observed map is recomputed after Cargo and compared with the pre-build map; stale sources, altered or extra artifacts, mid-build changes, and even a consistent mid-build rebuild are rejected.
The tests accurately label doubles and prove rejection before compilation or record issuance. They do not claim a real linker, PE or rendered UI result.
No product authority, production runtime setting, controller, or task state is changed by this correction.
limitations: The observations establish stable interval endpoints, not an atomic snapshot against a hostile same-account writer that changes and restores bytes during compilation.

The actual build must establish that its effective Cargo target/output path is the repo target path whose executable is verified and hashed. The existing tool_environment inherits Cargo environment overrides; alternate-target behavior was not exercised because this review prohibited Cargo/build invocation.
This review does not establish final executable publication atomicity or a final commit-bound task disposition.
The prior b937 picker bytes were unavailable for independent comparison. Actual native-ui observations remain bound only to their then-source; the later d922 tests do not rewrite that history.
mutations: This advisory report only; no production edits, Git mutation, task transition, native build or UI action.
